find: serving the approximately 430,000 Sikhs in Britain
replace: serving the approximately 535,000 Sikhs in Britain
note: F1: 430,000 is the 2011 census level. The 2021 census counted 524,140 Sikhs in England and Wales and the 2022 Scottish census 10,988.

find: the largest gurdwara outside India — which can accommodate over 3,000 worshippers
replace: the largest gurdwara in Britain — which can accommodate 3,000 worshippers

find: There is no distinction between where men and women sit in the prayer hall of a gurdwara; they may sit on either side or intermixed, depending on local practice, but the principle is complete equality.
replace: In many gurdwaras men sit on one side and women on the other, but this is not compulsory and practice varies. Both sides sit the same distance from the Guru Granth Sahib and at the same level, so the principle of complete equality is kept.
note: F3: divided seating is common in gurdwaras; the old wording denied it.
